page.overview:
Who is Aldebrand Ludenhof?

Aldebrand Ludenhof, titled the Grand Baron of Hochland, Marshal of the Talabec Reach, Defender of the Shrines and Baron of Hergig, is the Elector Count of the Electoral Province of Hochland in the Empire.

Ludenhof has been Elector Count of the Electoral Province of Hochland in the Empire since the Turmoil of 2512 IC led to a major political reorganisation of the Imperial administration.

Although Hochland is not an especially large or important province its count was one of the most valiant leaders in the Empire. Aldebrand was very tall and thin, but immensely strong and fit, making him a match for larger, heavier opponents in combat. He had an unquenchable enthusiasm for hunting, and specially for hawking.

Aldebrand's palace lay outside the capital of Hergig, surrounded by prime hunting estates. He was especially proud of his large collection of hunting birds, which occupied a substantial mews and tended to spill out into the palace itself, so that every room had at least one large bird of prey on its perch. Even in battle the Count carried a hawk upon his arm.
